senses.gloss:
लोह लोह, अस्, आ, अम् (probably a later
form of रोह, fr. rt. 1. रुह्, or fr. a lost rt. रुध्,
cf. रोहित, लोहित, रुधिर), red, reddish, copper-
coloured; made of copper, coppery; made of iron;
(अस्, अम्), m. n. red metal, copper; iron (either
crude or wrought); steel; any metal; gold; a
weapon; a fish-hook; blood; (अस्), m. the red goat
[cf. लोहाज]; a proper N.; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
people; (अम्), n. aloe wood, Agallochum.
—लोह-
कण्टक, अस्, m. a kind of thorny shrub, Vanguiera
Spinosa.
—लोह-कान्त, अस्, m. a magnet, loadstone.
—लोह-कार, अस्, m. a worker in iron, smelter of
iron, iron-smith, blacksmith; (ई), f., N. of the Tantra
goddess Atibalā.
—लोह-कारक, अस्, m. an iron-
smith, blacksmith.
—लोहकार-भस्त्रा, f. a black-
smith's bellows.
—लोह-किट्ट, अम्, n. rust of iron
or iron filings.
—लोह-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a moun-
tain.
—लोह-घातक, अस्, m. ‘iron-striker,’ a
blacksmith.
—लोह-चारिणी, f., N. of a river.
—लो-
ह-चूर्ण, अम्, n. rust of iron, iron filings.
—लोह-
ज, अम्, n. bell-metal; rust of iron or iron filings.
—लोह-जङ्घ, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman; (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a people.
—लोह-जाल, अम्, n. an
iron net, a coat of mail.
—लोह-जित्, त्, m. ‘con-
quering iron (in hardness), ‘a diamond.
—लोह-ता-
रणी, f., N. of a river, (also read लोह-तारिणी, लोह-
चारिणी.)
—लोह-दारक, अस्, m., N. of one of the
twenty-one hells (Manu IV. 90).
—लोह-द्राविन्,
ई, इणी, इ, melting copper or iron, fusing metal; (ई),
m. borax.
—लोह-नगर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—लोह-नाल, अस्, m. an iron arrow.
—लोह-पाश,
अस्, m. an iron chain.
—लोह-पुर, N. of a place.
—लोह-पृष्ठ, अस्, m. ‘iron-backed,’ a heron.
—लोह-प्रतिमा, f. an iron image; an anvil.
—लोह-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, studded with iron (as
a war-club).
—लोह-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of iron
or copper, composed or consisting of iron, iron.
—लोह-मारक, अस्, इका, अम्, calcining metal;
(अस्), m. Achyranthes Triandra.
—लोह-मुक्तिका, f.
a red pearl.
—लोह-मेखल, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing
a metal girdle; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs
attending on Skanda.
—लोह-यष्टी, f., N. of a
place.
—लोह-रजस्, अस्, n. iron-dust, rust of iron
or iron filings.
—लोह-राजक, अम्, n. silver.
—लो-
ह-लिङ्ग, अम्, n. a boil or abscess filled with blood.
—लोह-वर, अम्, n. the most precious metal, gold.
—लोह-वर्मन्, अ, n. iron armour, mail.
—लोह-
वाल, अस्, m. a kind of rice. —लोह-शङ्कु^1, उस्, m.
an iron pike, iron stake or spike; (उस्), m. ‘iron-
spiked, ‘N. of one of the twenty-one hells (Manu
IV. 90).
—लोह-श्लेषण, अस्, ई, अम्, uniting
metals; (अस्), m. borax.
—लोह-सङ्कर, अम्, n.
blue steel.
—लोहाकर (˚ह-आक्˚), अस्, m., N. of a
town.
—लोहा-कर्ण, अस्, ई, अम् (लोहा for लोह),
Ved. red-eared.
—लोहाङ्गारक (˚ह-अङ्˚), N. of a
hell (‘pit of red-hot charcoal’).
—लोहाचल (˚ह-
अच्˚), अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—लोहाज (˚ह-
अज), अस्, m. the red goat.
—लोहाज-वक्त्र, अस्,
m., N. of one of Skanda's attendants.
—लोहाण्ड
(˚ह-अण्˚ or ˚ह-आण्˚), see Gaṇa Gaurādi to Pāṇ.
IV. 1, 41.
—लोहाभिसार (˚ह-अभ्˚), अस्, m., N.
of a military ceremony performed on the tenth day
after the Nī-rājana, (this ceremony or lustration of
arms was formerly observed by kings before com-
mencing a campaign, but is now usually confined to
the domestic decoration and worship of the soldiers’
weapons); = लोहाभिहार.
—लोहाभिहार (˚ह-
[]
अभ्˚), अस्, m. = नी-राजन.
—लोहामिष (˚ह-
आम्˚), अम्, n. the flesh of the red-haired goat.
—लो-
हायस (˚ह-आय्˚), अम्, n., Ved. any metal mixed
with copper.
—लोहार्गल (˚ह-अर्˚), अम्, n., N.
of a Tīrtha.
—लोहोत्तम (˚ह-उत्˚), अम्, n. the
best metal, gold.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161210. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/322, batch 311-315. note: dental nasal -> guttural.

लोहक = लोह in अष्ट-लोहक, इन्दु-ल्˚, त्रि-ल्˚,
पञ्च-ल्˚.

लोहल, अस्, आ, अम्, iron, made of iron; lisping,
speaking inarticulately; (अस्), m. the principal ring
of a chain (?) .
लोहि, n. a kind of borax.

लोहिका, f. an iron pot or vessel (being a sort of
large shallow bowl, sometimes of iron, but usually
of wood and bound with iron, used for washing
rice, &c.).

1. लोहित, अस्, आ or लोहिनी, अम् (a later form of
रोहित, q. v.), red, red-coloured, reddish; made of
copper, copper, metal; (अस्), m. red (the colour),
any red colour; a particular disease attacking the
eyelids; a kind of precious stone; a species of rice;
a sort of bean or lentil; Dioscorea Purpurea; a kind
of fish, Cyprinus Rohita; a sort of deer; a snake,
serpent; the planet Mars; N. of a Nāga or serpent-
demon; of a river (the Brahma-putra); of a sea; of
a lake; of a country; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class
of gods under the twelfth Manu; the descendants
of Lohita; (आ), f., N. of one of the seven tongues
of fire; of two plants (= वराह-क्रान्ता, रक्त-
पुनर्नवा); = लोहिनी below; (इनी), f. a woman
with a red-coloured skin or red with anger; (अम्),
n. copper, metal; blood, (in this sense also अस्, m.);
battle; saffron; red sanders; a kind of sandal-wood
(= गो-शीर्ष); a kind of Agallochum; an imperfect
form of rainbow.
—लोहित-कल्माष, अस्, ई, अम्,
variegated with red, red-spotted.
—लोहित-कूट, N.
of a place.
—लोहित-कृष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, of a
reddish black colour, dark-red.
—लोहित-क्षय,
अस्, m. loss of blood.
—लोहित-क्षयक, अस्, आ,
अम्, suffering from loss of blood.
—लोहित-क्षीर,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. yielding red or bloody milk.
—लो-
हित-गङ्ग, N. of a place; (अम्), ind, where the
Ganges appears red.
—लोहित-गङ्गक, N. of a
place.
—लोहित-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, red-necked, hav-
ing a red neck; (अस्), m. epithet of Agni.
—लोहित-
चन्दन, अम्, n. saffron.
—लोहित-जह्नु, उस्, m.
a proper N.
—लोहित-ता, f. or लोहित-त्व, अम्, n.
redness, red colour.
—लोहित-ध्वज, अस्, आ, अम्,
red-bannered, having a red flag; (आस्), m. pl., N. of
a particular association of persons.
—लोहित-नयन,
अस्, आ, अम्, red-eyed, having the eyes reddened with
anger or passion.
—लोहित-पाद-देश, अस्, m., N.
of a place.
—लोहित-पित्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, subject to
hemorrhage, suffering from hemorrhage; [cf. रक्त-
पित्तिन्.]
—लोहित-पुर, N. of a place.
—लोहित-
पुष्प, अस्, आ, अम्, red-flowering, bearing red
flowers.
—लोहित-पुष्पक, अस्, आ, अम्, red-flower-
ing; (अस्), m. the granate tree.
—लोहित-मुक्ता, f.
a red pearl.
—लोहित-मृत्तिका, f. red earth, red
chalk, ruddle.
—लोहित-राग, अस्, m. a red colour,
red hue.
—लोहित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing blood.
—लोहित-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having red or blood-
stained garments.
—लोहित-शतपत्त्र, अम्, n. a
red lotus-flower.
—लोहित-शवल or लोहित-सारङ्-
ग, अस्, आ, अम् variegated with red, dappled with red.
 — 1. लोहिताक्ष (˚त-अक्˚), अस्, m. a red die (used
in gaming).
—२. लोहिताक्ष (˚त-अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्,
red-eyed; (अस्), m. a kind of snake; the Indian
cuckoo; N. of Viṣṇu; of one of Skanda's attend-
ants; of a man; (ई), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs
attending on Skanda; scil. सिरा, an artery or vein
situated either at the thigh-joint or at the arm-joint;
(अम्), n. a part of the arm and of the thigh, the
place where these are joined to the body, the arm-
joint, thigh-joint, hip.
—लोहिता-गिरि, इस्, m. (लोहिता
for लोहित), N. of a mountain.
—लोहिताङ्ग (˚त-
अङ्˚), अस्, m. ‘red-limbed,’ the planet Mars; a species
of plant (= कम्पिल्लक).
—लोहितानन (˚त-आन्˚),
अस्, ई, अम्, red-faced; (अस्), m. an ichneumon.
—लो-
हिता-मुखी, f., N. of a club (in the Rāmāyaṇa).
[]
—लोहितायस् (˚त-अय्˚), अस्, n. ‘red-iron,’ copper.
—लोहितायस, अस्, आ, अम्, made of red metal; (अम्),
n. (probably) copper.
—लोहितार्ण (˚त-अर्˚), अस्,
m. a proper N.
—लोहितार्द्र (˚त-आर्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, wet or dripping with blood, soaked in blood.
—लोहितार्मन् (˚त-अर्˚), अ, n. a red swelling or
blood-shot appearance in the whites of the eyes.
—लोहितावभास (˚त-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a
red appearance, reddish.
—लोहिताशोक (˚त-अश्˚),
अस्, m. a red-flowering Aśoka.
—लोहिताश्व (˚त-
अश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having or driving red horses.
—लो-
हितास्य (˚त-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a red or blood-
stained mouth.
—लोहिताहि (˚त-अहि), इस्, m. a red
snake.
—लोहिती-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to be
or become red, to be reddened.
—लोहितेक्षण
(˚त-ईक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, red-eyed.
—लोहितैत (˚त-
एत), अस्, आ, अम्, = रोहितैत, variegated with red.
—लोहितोत्पल (˚त-उत्˚), अम्, n. the flower of
Nymphæa Rubra.
—लोहितोद (˚त-उद), अस्, आ,
अम्, having blood-red water, having red water, hav-
ing blood instead of water; (अस्), m., N. of a parti-
cular hell.
—लोहितोर्ण (˚त-ऊर्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having
red wool.

2. लोहित, Nom. P. लोहितति, &c., to be or become
red, redden.

लोहितक, अस्, इका or लोहिनिका, अम्, red, of a
red colour, reddish; (अस्), m. a ruby; a kind of rice;
the planet Mars; N. of a Stūpa; (इका), f. a parti-
cular vein or artery; a species of plant; (अम्), n.
bell-metal; calx of brass.

लोहिताय, Nom. P. A. लोहितायति, -ते, &c., to
be or become red, redden, grow red.

लोहितायन, अस्, m. a patronymic, (probably for
लौहितायन.)

लोहितायनि, इस्, f. a patronymic, (perhaps for लौ-
हितायनि.)
लोहितिमन्, आ, m. redness, red colour.

लोहित्य, अस्, m. a kind of rice; N. of a man; of
the Brahma-putra river; of a village; (आ), f., N. of a
celestial female (in Hari-vaṃśa 9534); of a river.
लोहिनीका, f. (fr. लोहिनी), Ved. red glow or lustre.

लोहिन्य, अस्, m. a patronymic, (probably for लो-
हित्य.)
